ps.en: At the [[outset]] of her career, Lin was offered steady [[employment]] at a small firm that would [[enable]] her to support her family. She did not expect to [[encounter]] so much resistance on her very first day.
ps.zh: 职业生涯的伊始，林在一家小公司得到了一份稳定的工作，足以养家。她没料到，第一天就碰上这么多阻力。

ps.en: Her manager tried to [[encourage]] her, yet the project seemed headed for an early [[end]]. When Lin chose to [[endeavor]] for a fairer schedule, a few colleagues refused to [[endorse]] her plan.
ps.zh: 经理试图鼓励她，可项目眼看就要早早收场。当林选择为更公平的排班而努力时，几个同事拒绝支持她的方案。

ps.en: Data began to [[indicate]] a quiet problem; every [[indication]] was [[indicative]] of burnout. The unfair rule sparked real [[outrage]], but Lin held her ground.
ps.zh: 数据开始显露出一处隐忧；每一点迹象都指向职业倦怠。那条不公的规定引发了真正的愤怒，但林寸步不让。

ps.en: A [[specialist]] was hired to [[specialize]] in a rare plant [[species]] found only [[outside]] its natural pond. Her title sounded [[special]], yet her real [[specialty]] was soil chemistry — the quiet work nobody had asked her to do.
ps.zh: 一位专家受聘专攻一种只在原生水塘之外才能见到的稀有植物。她的头衔听着很特殊，可真正的专长其实是土壤化学——那份没人要求她做的安静工作。

ps.en: Colleagues asked for a [[specific]] [[specification]] and wanted her to [[specify]] the exact light it needed. From the [[outward]] signs, they began to [[speculate]] about a second, hidden bloom.
ps.zh: 同事们索要一份具体的规格，要她明确写出这种植物所需的确切光照。从外在的迹象看，他们开始猜测还有第二次、隐秘的花期。

ps.en: The study earned wide [[acclaim]]; its careful method became a model for others. What looked outwardly simple was, in fact, years of patient work.
ps.zh: 这项研究赢得了广泛赞誉；它严谨的方法成了他人效仿的范本。表面上看着简单，背后却是多年耐心的积累。

ps.en: The new [[accountant]] was asked to [[account]] for a missing [[bill]] worth a [[billion]]. To [[accommodate]] the audit, the firm offered him temporary [[accommodation]] near the office.
ps.zh: 新来的会计被要求对一张价值十亿的缺失账单作出说明。为了配合审计，公司在办公室附近给他提供了临时住所。

ps.en: A rival firm would [[bid]] to take over, and the [[charge]] of fraud began to [[accompany]] every meeting. Though raised with a slight [[bias]] against him, the team learned to trust his calm [[charm]].
ps.zh: 一家对手公司准备出价收购，诈骗的指控开始伴随每一次会议而来。尽管起初团队对他略有偏见，他们还是学会信赖他沉稳的魅力。

ps.en: He managed to [[accomplish]] the review before the [[birth]] of his first child. In the end, the honest accountant proved that numbers, not noise, decide everything.
ps.zh: 他赶在第一个孩子出生前完成了审查。最终，这位诚实的会计证明了：决定一切的，是数字而非喧哗。

ps.en: The local [[department]] refused to [[deny]] a peaceful [[demonstration|demonstrate]] calling for greater [[democracy]] and more [[democratic]] reform. Protesters would [[demand]] that the city [[denote]] each park as public land.
ps.zh: 当地部门拒绝否决一场呼吁更多民主改革的和平示威。抗议者要求市政府把每一座公园都标注为公共用地。

ps.en: A [[demographic]] study helped demonstrate the need for change; the old [[denial]] of fair access could no longer hold. Many families, [[dependent]] on cheap transit, came to [[depend]] on the new plan.
ps.zh: 一项人口统计研究佐证了变革的必要性；过去对公平准入的否认再也站不住脚。许多依赖廉价交通的家庭，开始指望这项新方案。

ps.en: When banks refused to [[deposit]] their savings safely, hope began to [[depress]] the crowd. Still, they would not [[chase]] power for its own sake, only dignity.
ps.zh: 当银行拒绝安全保管他们的存款，希望开始让人群陷入消沉。但他们并不为权力本身而追逐，只为一口尊严。

ps.en: An [[emergency]] forced the town to [[emerge]] from sleep; an [[eminent]] doctor led the response. His calm [[feeling]] kept the [[fearful]] crowd from panic, though private [[fear]] still lingered.
ps.zh: 一场突发状况让小镇从睡梦中惊醒；一位卓越的医生牵头应对。他冷静的情绪让惊恐的人群免于慌乱，尽管私下的恐惧仍在徘徊。

ps.en: The [[federal]] [[federation]] sent trucks to [[feed]] those trapped, and early [[feedback]] praised the effort. One [[feature]] of the plan stood out: it protected the most [[fertile]] fields first.
ps.zh: 联邦联盟派出卡车为被困者提供食物，早期的反馈称赞了这一努力。方案有一个特点格外突出：它优先保护最肥沃的田地。

ps.en: The true [[goal]] was not to move [[goods]] but to save lives. In crisis, [[emotion]] and reason had to work as one.
ps.zh: 真正的目标不是搬运物资，而是拯救生命。在危机中，情感与理智必须合而为一。

ps.en: A freshly minted [[graduate]] received a [[grant]] from the [[government]] to study public [[health]]. The [[governor]] praised her plan, calling it both [[grand]] and practical.
ps.zh: 一名刚毕业的学生获得政府资助，去研究公共卫生。州长称赞她的方案，说它既宏大又务实。

ps.en: She would not [[hesitate]] to [[immerse]] herself in the work, knowing that [[healthy]] habits prevent more than they [[heal]]. A [[heap]] of old reports helped her see the [[immediate]] need for clean water.
ps.zh: 她毫不犹豫地投身工作，因为她懂得：健康的习惯重在预防，而非治疗。一大堆旧报告让她看清了对清洁用水的迫切需求。

ps.en: Progress was [[gradual]], yet the findings were [[highly]] praised; one chart would [[highlight]] an [[immense]] gap. Her model would [[govern]] how the region treated health for a generation.
ps.zh: 进展是渐进的，可结论却备受赞誉；一张图表凸显出巨大的缺口。她的模型将决定这一地区整整一代人如何对待健康。

words.dif: employment 泛指受雇状态；career 强调职业发展；job 是具体岗位
words.pat: Stable employment is the foundation of a stable family life.
words.patZh: 稳定的工作是稳定家庭生活的基础。

c: enable sb to do 使…能够做
words.dif: enable 强调「提供条件使之可能」；allow 只是「不阻止」
words.pat: Education enables young people to shape their own future.
words.patZh: 教育让年轻人有能力塑造自己的未来。

words.dif: encounter 多指「意外或被动遭遇」；meet 是中性「见面」
words.pat: Travelers often encounter cultures very different from their own.
words.patZh: 旅人常会遇见与自身截然不同的文化。

c: encourage sb to do 鼓励…做
words.dif: encourage 是「正面鼓励」；stimulate 是「刺激、激发」，中性
words.pat: Teachers should encourage students to ask difficult questions.
words.patZh: 教师应鼓励学生提出棘手的问题。

c: at the end of 在…末尾
bring to an end 使结束
make ends meet 收支相抵
words.dif: end 作名词指「终点」，作动词指「终止」；finish 仅作动词
words.pat: Every story must come to an end, yet learning need not.
words.patZh: 每个故事都会结束，学习却不必。

c: make every endeavor 竭尽全力
fam: endeavour（英式拼写） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: endeavor 较正式，强调「认真努力」；try 口语且随意
words.pat: We should endeavor to understand views different from our own.
words.patZh: 我们应努力去理解不同于己见的观点。

c: endorse a plan 支持方案
endorse a product 代言产品
endorse a cheque 背书支票
words.dif: endorse 可指「公开支持」也可指「支票背书」，阅读常考第一义
words.pat: Few politicians dared to endorse the unpopular reform.
words.patZh: 几乎没有政客敢公开支持这项不受欢迎的改革。

c: indicate a problem 显示问题
words.dif: indicate 常用「数据/迹象表明」；point out 是「明确指出」
words.pat: Rising temperatures indicate a changing global climate.
words.patZh: 气温上升表明全球气候正在变化。

c: give an indication 给出迹象
a clear indication 明确迹象
words.dif: indication 是「迹象、征兆」；symbol 是「象征符号」，更抽象
words.pat: There is little indication that the economy will recover soon.
words.patZh: 几乎没有迹象表明经济会迅速复苏。

c: be indicative of 表明；暗示
an indicative mood 陈述语气
words.dif: indicative 几乎总与 of 搭配表「表明」；suggestive 偏「暗示、引人联想」
words.pat: High turnout is indicative of strong public concern.
words.patZh: 高投票率表明公众高度关切。

c: an outrage against 对…的暴行
words.dif: outrage 强调「因不公而起的强烈义愤」；anger 是一般「生气」
words.pat: The decision caused outrage among local residents.
words.patZh: 这一决定在当地居民中引发了公愤。

c: from the outset 从一开始
at the very outset 在最初
fam: out（外）+ set（放置） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: at the outset 强调「事情刚开始时」；in the beginning 更泛指「起初」
words.pat: It is wise to set clear goals at the outset of any project.
words.patZh: 在任何项目伊始就定下清晰目标，是明智之举。

words.exam: 外部；在外面；向外的；不属于…范围之内
c: outside the office 在办公室外
from the outside 从外面看
words.dif: outside 可作多种词性，核心是「外部、外面」；outer 只是「外层的」
words.pat: The truth is often hidden outside the official records.
words.patZh: 真相常常藏在官方记录的外部。

words.exam: 向外；向外的；外面的，外表的
c: an outward sign 外在迹象
words.dif: outward 指「向外的、外表的」；inward 是其反义「向内的」
words.pat: Outward success does not always reflect inner peace.
words.patZh: 外在的成功并不总是反映内心的安宁。

c: a special case 特殊情况
words.dif: special 强调「与众不同、特别」；specific 强调「明确具体」
words.pat: This case requires special attention from the committee.
words.patZh: 这件事需要委员会给予特别关注。

c: a specialist in 某方面的专家
consult a specialist 咨询专家
a heart specialist 心脏病专家
words.dif: specialist 指「某领域的专家」；generalist 是「通才」，为其反义
words.pat: Patients should see a specialist for complex conditions.
words.patZh: 病情复杂时，患者应去看专科医生。

c: specialize in 专攻；专门研究
specialize in law 专攻法律
words.dif: specialize in 后接领域；major in 多用于「大学主修」
words.pat: The clinic specializes in treating sleep disorders.
words.patZh: 这家诊所专治睡眠障碍。

c: a local specialty 地方特产
words.dif: specialty 指「专长、特产」；specialization 偏「专门化过程」
words.pat: Her specialty is turning difficult ideas into clear stories.
words.patZh: 她的专长，是把难懂的想法写成清晰的故事。

c: a rare species 稀有物种
words.dif: species 单复同形，指「物种」；breed 多指「动物品种」
words.pat: This species of frog has adapted to life in the city.
words.patZh: 这种青蛙已经适应了城市生活。

c: a specific reason 具体原因
to be specific 具体来说
words.dif: specific 是「明确具体的」；special 是「特殊的、特别的」
words.pat: We need a specific plan, not vague promises.
words.patZh: 我们需要一份具体的计划，而非空洞的承诺。

c: meet the specification 符合规格
a detailed specification 详细说明
words.dif: specification 是「规格、说明书」；spec 是其口语缩写
words.pat: The product failed to meet the safety specification.
words.patZh: 该产品未能达到安全规格要求。

c: specify in detail 详细说明
specify a date 指定日期
words.dif: specify 是「明确指定」；imply 是「暗示」，方向相反
words.pat: Please specify your preferred delivery time in the form.
words.patZh: 请在表格中明确写出您偏好的送达时间。

words.dif: speculate 既表「推测」也表「投机买卖」；guess 仅指「猜」
words.pat: It is unwise to speculate about causes before the facts are known.
words.patZh: 在真相未明前就推测原因，是不明智的。

words.exam: 欢呼；高度评价；称赞；赞扬
words.dif: acclaim 是「高度评价、喝彩」，较正式；praise 是一般「称赞」
words.pat: Her first novel won acclaim from readers across the country.
words.patZh: 她的处女作赢得了全国读者的赞誉。

c: accommodate a need 满足需求
words.dif: accommodate 可指「容纳、接待」也可指「适应、迁就」；adapt 只是「适应」
words.pat: The new system can accommodate up to ten thousand users.
words.patZh: 这套新系统最多可容纳一万名用户。

words.dif: accommodation 英式常作不可数；美式常用复数 accommodations
words.pat: The company offers free accommodation to new employees.
words.patZh: 公司为新员工提供免费住宿。

c: accompany a letter 附上信件
words.dif: accompany 强调「陪同、伴随」；follow 是「跟随在后」
words.pat: A rise in prices is often accompanied by a fall in demand.
words.patZh: 物价上涨常伴随着需求下降。

words.exam: 达到；完成；实现（计划、诺言等）
c: accomplish a task 完成任务
accomplish one's goal 实现目标
words.dif: accomplish 强调「达成、做成」；finish 侧重「做完」
words.pat: Small daily habits help us accomplish large goals.
words.patZh: 每日的小习惯助我们成就大目标。

words.exam: 账目；账户；叙述；说明；解释；占
words.dif: account 名词「账户/叙述」，动词「说明、占比例」；count 是「数数」
words.pat: Tourism accounts for a large share of the local economy.
words.patZh: 旅游业在当地经济中占有很大比重。

c: a certified accountant 注册会计师
hire an accountant 雇一名会计
a tax accountant 税务会计
words.dif: accountant 是「会计师」；auditor 偏「审计师」
words.pat: A good accountant can save a business both time and tax.
words.patZh: 一位好会计能为企业省下时间与税金。

c: a bias against 对…的偏见
words.dif: bias 可作名词「偏见」也可作动词「使有偏见」；prejudice 多作名词
words.pat: The test was designed to be free of any cultural bias.
words.patZh: 这项测试的设计力求不含任何文化偏见。

words.exam: 争取；出价；投标；努力；尝试
c: a bid to win 取胜的努力
words.dif: bid 作动词名词都表「出价、投标、试图」；offer 是「主动提供」
words.pat: Several firms bid for the right to build the bridge.
words.patZh: 好几家公司都出价竞标修建这座桥的权利。

c: pass a bill 通过法案
a ten-dollar bill 十美元钞票
words.dif: bill 可指「账单、法案、钞票」；law 仅指「法律」
words.pat: The committee will debate the new education bill next week.
words.patZh: 委员会将于下周辩论这项新教育法案。

words.dif: billion 美式指「十亿」，英式传统指「万亿」，阅读需注意语境
words.pat: The project cost more than two billion dollars to complete.
words.patZh: 该项目完工耗资超过二十亿美元。

c: give birth to 生下；产生
date of birth 出生日期
words.dif: birth 指「出生、出身」；birthplace 是「出生地」
words.pat: The reform gave birth to a new generation of startups.
words.patZh: 这场改革催生了新一代初创企业。

words.exam: 要（价）；收（费）；使充电；控告；指控
c: charge a fee 收取费用
words.dif: charge 多义：收费、充电、指控；accuse 仅指「指控」
words.pat: The officer was charged with neglecting his duty.
words.patZh: 该警官被指控玩忽职守。

c: a natural charm 天生的魅力
charm sb into 用魅力说服
words.dif: charm 可作名词「魅力」或动词「迷住」；appeal 多作名词「吸引力」
words.pat: The old town still retains its quiet charm.
words.patZh: 这座古镇依然保留着它静谧的魅力。

c: chase a dream 追逐梦想
words.dif: chase 强调「追逐、追赶」；pursue 更正式、可指「追求目标」
words.pat: Many young people chase status rather than meaning.
words.patZh: 许多年轻人追逐地位，而非意义。

c: meet a demand 满足需求
words.dif: demand 语气强，表「坚决要求」；ask 是一般「请求」
words.pat: Citizens demand greater transparency from the government.
words.patZh: 公民要求政府更加透明。

c: a liberal democracy 自由民主国家
words.dif: democracy 指「民主制度或民主国家」；republic 强调「共和政体」
words.pat: Education is the lifeblood of any healthy democracy.
words.patZh: 教育是一切健康民主制度的命脉。

c: a democratic society 民主社会
words.dif: democratic 是「民主的」；democrat 是「民主主义者」，名词
words.pat: A more democratic process gives voice to the weak.
words.patZh: 更民主的程序让弱者也能发声。

words.exam: 人口统计学的；人口统计的
words.dif: demographic 是「人口统计的」；geographic 是「地理的」，形近易混
words.pat: Demographic shifts are reshaping the labor market.
words.patZh: 人口结构的变化正在重塑劳动力市场。

words.exam: 论证；证明；表明；游行；示威
c: demonstrate a skill 展示技能
words.dif: demonstrate 可指「论证/展示」也可指「示威游行」；prove 仅「证明」
words.pat: Experiments demonstrate that practice improves memory.
words.patZh: 实验证明，练习能改善记忆力。

c: denote a change 表示变化
X denotes Y X 表示 Y
a symbol denoting peace 象征和平的符号
words.dif: denote 是「字面表示」；connote 是「隐含、联想」
words.pat: In this chart, a red line denotes rising prices.
words.patZh: 在这张图里，红线表示物价上涨。

c: a denial of 对…的否认
deny a request 拒绝请求
words.dif: denial 是名词「否认、拒绝」；deny 是其动词
words.pat: His denial of the problem only made it worse.
words.patZh: 他对这个问题的否认，只会让情况更糟。

c: deny a charge 否认指控
words.dif: deny 是「否认、拒绝给予」；refuse 是「拒绝做」
words.pat: No one can deny the value of honest work.
words.patZh: 没有人能否认诚实劳动的价值。

c: a university department 大学院系
words.dif: department 指「部门、系」；division 也指「部门」但偏「分部」
words.pat: She works in the research department of a tech firm.
words.patZh: 她在一家科技公司的研究部门工作。

c: depend heavily on 严重依赖
words.dif: depend on 后接对象；rely on 语气更个人化
words.pat: Children depend on adults for safety and guidance.
words.patZh: 儿童的安全与引导，依赖成年人。

words.exam: 依靠的；依赖的；取决于…的；受扶养者
c: a dependent child 受扶养子女
words.dif: dependent 是「依赖的」（反义 independent）；dependant 指「受扶养者」拼写近似
words.pat: A healthy economy is not dependent on a single industry.
words.patZh: 健康的经济不依赖单一产业。

c: a bank deposit 银行存款
deposit a cheque 存入支票
words.dif: deposit 可作动词「存放、存款」或名词「存款、保证金」；withdraw 是「取」
words.pat: He deposited his savings in a trusted local bank.
words.patZh: 他把积蓄存入了一家可信的本地银行。

c: depress the economy 使经济萧条
words.dif: depress 是「使消沉、使萧条」；suppress 是「镇压、抑制」
words.pat: Rising unemployment tends to depress consumer spending.
words.patZh: 失业率上升往往会抑制消费支出。

words.dif: emerge 强调「从隐蔽中显露」；appear 是一般「出现」
words.pat: New leaders emerge when old systems fail.
words.patZh: 旧制度崩塌时，新的领导者便会涌现。

c: in an emergency 在紧急情况下
declare an emergency 宣布进入紧急状态
words.dif: emergency 是「突发的紧急情况」；urgency 是「紧迫性」，抽象
words.pat: The hospital is ready for any medical emergency.
words.patZh: 这家医院随时准备应对任何医疗紧急情况。

words.exam: 著名的；杰出的；卓越的；明显的
c: an eminent scientist 杰出科学家
an eminent figure 知名人物
words.dif: eminent 指「（人）卓越、著名」；imminent 是「（事）迫近的」，拼写极近
words.pat: An eminent doctor led the response to the outbreak.
words.patZh: 一位卓越的医生牵头应对了这次暴发。

c: a mix of emotions 复杂的情绪
words.dif: emotion 是「情绪、情感」总称；feeling 偏「具体感受」
words.pat: Reason and emotion both shape human decisions.
words.patZh: 理性与情感共同塑造人的决定。

c: out of fear 出于恐惧
words.dif: fear 可作名词「恐惧」或动词「害怕」；fright 多指「惊吓」
words.pat: Fear of failure should not stop us from trying.
words.patZh: 对失败的恐惧，不应阻止我们尝试。

c: a fearful scene 可怕的场面
words.dif: fearful 指「感到害怕的」或「可怕的」；fearsome 只指「令人害怕的」
words.pat: The fearful crowd was kept calm by clear instructions.
words.patZh: 在清晰指令下，惊恐的人群保持了镇定。

c: a key feature 关键特征
feature in 出现在；以…为特色
fam: featured adj. 被特别推荐的
words.dif: feature 可作名词「特征、特写」或动词「以…为特色」；trait 仅名词
words.pat: Honesty is a feature of every strong community.
words.patZh: 诚实是每个强健社群的一个特征。

words.dif: federal 是「联邦的」；central 是「中央的」，未必联邦
words.pat: The federal government sets broad national policy.
words.patZh: 联邦政府制定宽泛的全国性政策。

c: a trade federation 行业联盟
form a federation 组建联盟
the federation of states 各州联邦
words.dif: federation 指「联邦、联盟」；confederation 是「邦联」，更松散
words.pat: The federation sent aid to the affected regions.
words.patZh: 该联盟向受灾地区送去了援助。

c: feed the hungry 喂养饥民
feed data into 将数据输入
words.dif: feed 可作「喂养」或「提供（信息/数据）」；raise 多指「饲养家畜」
words.pat: Sensors feed data into the city's traffic system.
words.patZh: 传感器把数据输入城市的交通系统。

words.dif: feedback 是「反馈意见」；feed 是「输入」，方向相反
words.pat: Regular feedback helps workers improve their skills.
words.patZh: 定期的反馈能帮助员工提升技能。

c: a feeling of 一种…的感觉
hurt one's feelings 伤害感情
words.dif: feeling 偏「具体感受、心情」；emotion 是「情绪」总称
words.pat: A feeling of belonging keeps a team together.
words.patZh: 归属感让一个团队凝聚在一起。

c: a fertile mind 富有创造力的头脑
words.dif: fertile 指「肥沃的、能繁殖的」；barren 是其反义「贫瘠的」
words.pat: Fertile fields feed far more people than barren ones.
words.patZh: 肥沃的田地养活的人，远多于贫瘠之地。

c: achieve a goal 实现目标
set a goal 设定目标
words.dif: goal 可指「目标」也可指「球门、进球」；aim 仅「目标」
words.pat: Education should serve the goal of human flourishing.
words.patZh: 教育应当服务于人类繁荣这一目标。

c: goods and services 商品与服务
words.dif: goods 是「商品、货物」（只用复数）；cargo 是「船/机载货物」
words.pat: The region trades its goods with neighboring countries.
words.patZh: 该地区与邻国进行商品贸易。

words.exam: 统治；管理；决定；支配；控制
c: govern a country 治理国家
govern one's temper 控制情绪
words.dif: govern 强调「统治、支配」；rule 偏「统治、裁决」
words.pat: Good data should govern how we allocate resources.
words.patZh: 优质的数据应当决定我们如何分配资源。

words.dif: government 指「政府、治理」；regime 偏「政权（常含贬义）」
words.pat: The government pledged to cut carbon emissions.
words.patZh: 政府承诺削减碳排放。

c: the central bank governor 央行行长
words.dif: governor 指「州长、主管」；mayor 是「市长」，层级不同
words.pat: The governor praised the plan as both bold and practical.
words.patZh: 州长称赞该方案既大胆又务实。

words.dif: gradual 是「逐渐的、分步的」；sudden 是其反义「突然的」
words.pat: Climate change is a gradual but relentless process.
words.patZh: 气候变化是一个渐进却无情的过程。

words.exam: （使）（大学）毕业；获学位；大学）毕业生；获（学士）学位者
words.dif: graduate 可作动词「毕业」或名词「毕业生」；degree 是「学位」
words.pat: She graduated with honors in public health.
words.patZh: 她以优等成绩毕业于公共卫生专业。

words.exam: 重大的；主要的；盛大的；豪华的
c: a grand plan 宏大的计划
a grand ceremony 盛大的典礼
words.dif: grand 可指「宏大的、盛大的」或「重大的」；big 只是「大」
words.pat: The mayor announced a grand scheme to rebuild the port.
words.patZh: 市长宣布了一项重建港口的宏大方案。

c: grant a request 准许请求
take for granted 视为理所当然
a research grant 研究资助
words.dif: grant 是「授予、准予」；give 是一般「给」
words.pat: The foundation granted her a scholarship to study abroad.
words.patZh: 该基金会授予她一笔留学奖学金。

c: heap praise on 大加赞扬
fam: heap（自身名动同形） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: heap 指「一堆、大量」；pile 也是「堆」，常可互换
words.pat: A heap of old reports revealed the true need.
words.patZh: 一大堆旧报告揭示出了真实的需求。

c: heal a wound 愈合伤口
heal the divide 弥合分歧
words.dif: heal 强调「愈合、调停」；cure 偏「治愈疾病」
words.pat: Honest dialogue can heal a divided community.
words.patZh: 真诚的对话能治愈一个分裂的社群。

c: in good health 身体健康
words.dif: health 是名词「健康」；healthy 是形容词「健康的」
words.pat: Clean water is the basis of public health.
words.patZh: 清洁饮用水是公共卫生的基础。

words.exam: 健康的；健壮的；有益健康的；卫生的
c: a healthy diet 健康饮食
a healthy economy 健康的经济
words.dif: healthy 指「健康的、有益健康的」；healthful 也指「有益健康的」，近义
words.pat: Healthy habits prevent more illness than they cure.
words.patZh: 健康的习惯重在预防，而非治疗。

words.dif: hesitate 是「犹豫、踌躇」；pause 只是「暂停」
words.pat: Do not hesitate to ask for help when you need it.
words.patZh: 需要帮助时，不要犹豫开口。

words.exam: 使突出；强调；最有意思或精彩的部分
c: highlight the need 突出需求
a key highlight 一大亮点
highlight a gap 凸显缺口
fam: highlight（自身名动同形） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: highlight 可作动词「强调、突出」或名词「亮点」；emphasize 仅动词
words.pat: The report highlights the gap between rich and poor.
words.patZh: 报告凸显了贫富之间的差距。

c: think highly of 高度评价
words.dif: highly 是副词「高度地、非常」；high 是形容词「高的」
words.pat: Her research is highly regarded by international peers.
words.patZh: 她的研究备受国际同行的推崇。

words.exam: 立即的；直接的；最接近的
c: immediate effect 立竿见影的效果
in the immediate area 在邻近区域
words.dif: immediate 指「立即的、直接的、最接近的」；prompt 偏「迅速的」
words.pat: The flood created an immediate need for clean water.
words.patZh: 洪水造成了对清洁用水的迫切需求。

c: an immense gap 巨大缺口
words.dif: immense 强调「庞大到难以衡量」；big 只是「大」
words.pat: The reform brought immense benefits to rural families.
words.patZh: 这场改革给农村家庭带来了巨大的益处。

words.exam: 使浸没；使沉浸在；使专心于
c: immerse in 沉浸于；专心于
words.dif: immerse 是「使沉浸、使专心于」；absorb 是「吸收、使专注」
words.pat: She immersed herself in the study of local health.
words.patZh: 她全身心投入到对当地健康的研究中。
